goal: Create a visual of the product in a realistic outdoor camping scene, with an authentic, restrained atmosphere, high-quality feel, suitable for brand main visuals or social media covers.

subject.product_name: Wacaco Minipresso GR2 portable hand-operated espresso machine
subject.visual_description: Cylindrical manual espresso machine with deep gray and orange accents, extracting a small stream of crema-colored coffee liquid into a transparent glass cup from a copper outlet
subject.position: Slightly below the center of the image, aligned with the wood grain texture.

scene.location: Foldable omelette table by the lakeside cedar forest, blurred tent entrance in the distance
scene.time_of_day: Around 6:40 AM in May, the thin mist over the lake will dissipate.
scene.weather_or_mood: Clear, dewy, and not yet noisy
extra_props: Small copper hand grinder with several coffee beans on waterproof oilcloth
Military green enamel cup as background layers
Pine needles and one or two wet pebbles decorate the foreground.

lighting.direction: Soft side light coming from the gaps in the woods on the left side, water surface slightly reflecting to fill the dark areas
lighting.color_temp: Slightly cool and leaning towards morning blue, with the coffee liquid providing warm points.

human_presence.rule: Depicting 'a cup just woken up' with unmanned still life.

style.rendering: Real photographic feel + delicate grain + medium-low saturation
style.depth: Shallow depth of field, the Italian espresso machine and cup rim are the most solid.
style.consistency: Military green, wood color, deep gray, lake surface gray-blue unified

must_keep: Lake water and forest scenery are realistic and perspective is correct
Like a lifestyle magazine rather than a hard advertisement
avoid: More than five items on the desktop.
